ns2:section.sectionText: Every two weeks, we will explore two sides of a thematic lens, one that considers the traditional development lens and the second that deconstructs this approach to deepen your internship experience and the ways you may think about it. The course plots a progression from an exploration of the self (you) into the organization you are interning with and then zooms out to a macro global scale. This course critically assesses power relationships, 'culture' in the workplace, learning and working styles, notions of privilege, access and the digital divide, higher education, professional development, notions of 'failure' and success' as well as what a life well lived, might look like, to you.
